subject: general
question: Identify the ACME thread.
solution:
**Concept**

 
• **ACME Thread:** It is a screw thread profile with a trapezoidal shape. It is primarily used for power transmission in machine tools like lead screws of lathes, vises, and jacks.
 
• **Angle:** The standard ACME thread has an included angle of 29^circ.
 
• **Comparison:**
 
 
• **Square Thread:** The flanks are perpendicular to the axis of the thread (angle is 0^circ or 90^circ profile).
 
• **Buttress Thread:** It has an asymmetrical profile designed to resist heavy axial loads in one direction only.
